items.title: from-scratch-neural-networks
items.summary: A collection of real multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) implemented from scratch in pure JavaScript. No frameworks, no external libraries, no runtime dependencies. Each app is a self-contained single HTML file that trains and runs a neural network entirely in the browser, with live visualization of the learning process.
items.summary_cn: 一个由纯JavaScript从头开始实现的真实多层感知器（MLP）集合。无框架、无外部库、无运行时依赖项。每个应用程序都是一个独立的单个 HTML 文件，它完全在浏览器中训练和运行神经网络，并实时可视化学习过程。

items.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
items.title_cn: 耶鲁大学的森嫩菲尔德：英伟达对美国工业实力“有害”——而非捍卫者
items.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.
items.summary_cn: 耶鲁大学的杰弗里·桑菲尔德（Jeffrey Sonnenfeld）警告称，周一市场欢呼雀跃的事件——即黄仁勋在白宫的支持下重返英伟达担任首席执行官和董事会成员——可能会被证明是一个巨大的错误，使董事们面临日益增多的诉讼所带来的“历史性”个人责任，并引发人们质疑该国是否在为一家曾帮助将先进芯片交到其对手手中的公司欢呼。
items.comment: 监管落地对行业是双刃剑，合规成本飙升，小玩家可能被挤出市场。

items.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
items.title_cn: 据报道，特朗普表示赦免黄仁勋“是一个选项”
items.summary: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.
items.summary_cn: 黄仁勋正面临着对其与Alice Huang关系的持续质疑，后者是一位据称与中国情报部门有联系的高管，此前曾就职于一家被指控非法将Nvidia芯片转运至中国的公司。
items.comment: 新趋势值得注意，别盲目跟风，适合自己的才是最好的。
